Is it really free?
Yes. Playing is free and there is nothing to buy on the site. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account and no newsletter, so you can open a game and start playing.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. All of the roughly 7,878 games run instantly in your browser, with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, for many games. Touch-friendly games are collected in the Mobile category, and games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn your phone sideways. A few older games need a keyboard and mouse, and they say so on their page.
Is it safe for children?
The site only carries family-friendly games, with no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Your recently played games, favourites and light or dark choice are kept in your own browser and never leave your device. Most games also save their own progress the same way. The catch is that clearing your browser data or using private mode will lose all of it.
What are the cookie settings about?
If you are in Europe, you are asked before any non-essential cookies are used. You can change your choice at any time with Cookie settings in the footer.
A game will not load. What can I do?
If a game will not start, email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and tell us which game it is, so we can look into it. Also check the game's page, since a few older games need a keyboard and mouse.
Where do the games come from?

Five games are made by Door 404, the studio behind the site. Others are licensed from the distribution networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, and 9 were sent in directly by independent developers. Games are never copied from other portals.
How do I submit my own game?
Go to https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. It is free and non-exclusive, and a real person plays every submission. Accepted games get their own page that credits you and links back to you.
Can I have my game removed?
Yes, at any time. Your game stays hosted on your own server, so just email contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will take it down.
Can I embed a game on my own site?

Only the site's own games, which have an Embed this game box with ready-made code on their page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence. You can find the studio's own games at /our-games/.
